codec.base: One uint8 maximum raw BF16 exponent per block
codec.delta: Consecutive 3- or 4-bit fields in uint32 words, low bit first
codec.sign_mantissa: Four unmodified sign|mantissa bytes per uint32 word
codec.escape: Maximum delta code. Row CSR uint32 entries pack raw BF16 in the high 16 bits and column in the low 16 bits. No entry means signed zero.
codec.accumulation: Resolve escapes before FMA. Both Metal GEMVs use identical lane traversal, FP32 FMA and simd_sum. Batch 1/4/8 reuses each decoded weight.

activations.prompt: When the river rose after a week of rain, the council inspected the old bridge. The surveyor marked the waterline, photographed the stonework, and wrote down which measurements the next team should repeat.

benchmark.timing: Wall-clock MLX eval and sync for six disjoint matrices, divided by six. Input preparation, graph construction and GPU eviction sweep are outside the timer.
benchmark.cache_protocol: Read a disjoint 256 MiB buffer on the GPU before each six-matrix sweep. Physical cache misses were not counted.
benchmark.bandwidth: Weight payload bytes per median elapsed time in decimal GB/s. Counts storage once per call, including escape data and row pointers.
